items.statement: The independent investigation retains candidate identity and validation context for the structures/states actually compared.
items.expected: Candidates are individually identified, deduplicated or distinguished, and their minimum/state-selection evidence and stopping rationale are reported.

items.statement: The selected candidate used for the vertical excitation is validated as a ground-state minimum.
items.expected: A frequency/Hessian or justified equivalent supports minimum status, with convergence diagnostics and failures disclosed.

items.statement: The selected lowest visible transition has an explicit electronic-character analysis.
items.expected: The report uses orbital, transition-density, attachment/detachment, NTO, or equivalent evidence to identify donor and acceptor regions, without relying on a bare label.

items.statement: The selected lowest-energy visible dye-3 transition is reported quantitatively in kcal/mol.
items.expected: A numeric energy with state label and provenance is submitted.
